front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《25》

en: Hyacinths bloom
Toward evening, a stretch of violet-blue
Imagining myself far away
The years always have their cracks
A light boat rows in, and reels up
Spring River, Flowers, Moonlit Night

zh: 蒼茫草原有歸雁遠去，之外
寥寂薄暮有芒草搖曳，之外
en: On the vast hazy grassland, wild geese return home and depart into the distance, and beyond that
In the desolate dusk the silver grass sways, and beyond
Sky eternal and vast, wind and moon of a single morning

points.zh:
宋代襌宗將參禪分為三重境界：
第一重境界：落葉满空山，何處尋行迹
第二重境界：空山無人，水流花開
第三重境界：萬古長空，一朝風月
points.en:
Song Dynasty Chan Buddhism divided the practice of meditation into three levels of realization:
First level: Fallen leaves fill the empty mountain — where can one seek their traces?
Second level: The empty mountain has no one in it, yet the water flows and the flowers bloom.
Third level: Throughout eternity, the vast sky; for one moment, wind and moon.

en: Upon the Aegean Sea
The setting sun hangs low like a seal-stamp
A scroll of myth, lightly signed
A night without starlight
Tree shadows, faint and indistinct
The lines of the poem utterly desolate

zh: 就這麼靜臥在你的掌心 ?
en: After a hundred and eight thousand miles, can we
Just lying quietly like this in the palm of your hand?
I asked the Tathagata Buddha
Cutting off a piece of the Aegean's blue
Setting it in the courtyard, waiting
Venus, gliding in over the waves

flow.caption_zh: 「等待維納斯」  柯鍚杰攝影作品   1979     希臘

points.zh:
「那是夏天的愛琴海，我在海色，天色和白牆之間，徘徊了二十多分鐘，我知道那裡有我想要的東西，但快門怎麼也按不下去。只好到附近轉一轉，看看海，在那裡呆坐了幾分鐘。終於回去按了快門。------，畫面如此安靜，簡潔，沒有任何多餘的東西。大自然被抽離得只剩下大面積的色塊，形狀和線條。但是簡單中仍富有變化和韻律，有一種「靜的力量」。照片中的生命力轉化為內歛，可以一直「看進去」的。後來詩人鄭愁予聽了這張照片的故事，他說 : 「啊，愛琴海是維納斯出現的地方，你在等待維納斯。」
-- ( 取自「心的視界 :  柯錫杰的攝影美學」 2006，大塊文化出版社 )
points.en:
"It was the Aegean Sea in summer. I lingered for over twenty minutes between the color of the sea, the color of the sky, and the white walls. I knew there was something there that I wanted, but I simply could not press the shutter. So I went to wander nearby, looked at the sea, and sat there for a few minutes. Finally I went back and pressed the shutter. ... The image is so quiet, so simple, with nothing superfluous. Nature has been distilled down to broad blocks of color, shapes, and lines. Yet within this simplicity there is still variation and rhythm -- a kind of 'power of stillness.' The vitality within the photograph turns inward, something one can keep 'looking into.' Later, when the poet Zheng Chouyu heard the story behind this photograph, he said: 'Ah, the Aegean is where Venus appeared -- you were waiting for Venus.'"
-- (From "The Vision of the Heart: The Photographic Aesthetics of Ke Hsi-chieh," 2006, Locus Publishing)

flow.caption_zh: 「 米可諾斯教堂」 柯鍚杰攝影作品   1979   希臘
「 觀海」 柯鍚杰攝影作品   1983   美國紐澤西州

points.zh: 柯錫杰（1929年-- ），出生于台灣台南市，早年赴日學習攝影，返國後，以高度精準的影像技術拍攝指揮家郭美貞、舞蹈家黃忠良等人物寫真，展現強烈個人的視覺風格，並且表達人物內在深層的精神。60 年代移居美國紐約，是少數能在美國紐約商業攝影界，獲得肯定的亞裔攝影師。1979 年為追求個人藝術創作的突破，柯錫杰結束紐約的工作室，獨自前往印度、南歐、北非，自駕旅行拍攝，歷時八個月，開創風格獨特的「心象風景」。以精確的技術和美感，傳達出文學「詩的意境」與美學「畫的質感」，使用「轉染法」的攝影作品，大幅提升了彩色攝影的藝術層次，引起專業攝影界極大的迴響。此時期的系列作品在台灣展出時，更造成一股旋風，也為台灣現代攝影界帶來深遠的影響，被尊稱為「台灣現代攝影第一人」，1993年，自紐約返台長居，並與妻子樊潔兮創辦潔兮杰舞團。 1994年，世界知名的紐約漢默畫廊（Hammer Gallery）為了他舉辦首次攝影作品展覽。1996年，在纽约参與Lizan-Top Gallery彩色攝影大師影展。2000年及2008年，代表作品「等待維納斯」分別於佳士得與羅芙奧拍賣公司，以攝影項目最高價成交，締造台灣攝影界的新記錄。
points.en: Ko Si-chi (1929– ), born in Tainan, Taiwan, went to Japan in his early years to study photography, and after returning home used highly precise imaging techniques to photograph portraits of figures such as the conductor Kuo Mei-chen and the dancer Huang Chung-liang, displaying a strong personal visual style and expressing the deep inner spirit of his subjects. In the 1960s he moved to New York, USA, becoming one of the few Asian photographers to gain recognition in the New York commercial photography world. In 1979, seeking a breakthrough in his personal artistic creation, Ko closed his New York studio and traveled alone, self-driving, through India, southern Europe, and North Africa for eight months, creating a distinctive style he called "psychological landscape." Through precise technique and aesthetic sense he conveyed the literary "poetic mood" and the artistic "painterly texture"; his photographic works using the "dye transfer" process greatly elevated the artistic level of color photography, drawing enormous response from the professional photography world. This series of works, when exhibited in Taiwan during this period, caused a sensation and had a profound influence on Taiwan's modern photography community, earning him the honorary title "the first man of modern Taiwanese photography." In 1993 he returned to settle permanently in Taiwan from New York, and together with his wife Fan Chieh-hsi founded the Chieh Hsi Chieh Dance Troupe. In 1994, the world-renowned Hammer Gallery in New York held his first photography exhibition. In 1996, he took part in an exhibition of color photography masters at the Lizan-Tops Gallery in New York. In 2000 and 2008, his representative work 'Waiting for Venus' was sold at Christie's and Ravenel auction houses respectively, each time setting a new record as the highest price ever paid for a photographic work by a Taiwanese artist.

en: Leave the window to the autumn sun
Leave imagination to the starlight
The wind passes through the bamboo grove, soundless
The maple leaf you gave me
In dust-covered pages, holding fast to
The dusk and misty rain of that year
Tired of walking
Then sit quietly with Monet, gazing far into thought
Water lilies, brimming full of

points.zh:
提及梵谷，就想像滿天星光璀燦，想起莫內，就浮現一池睡蓮繽紛。莫內 ( Claude Monet, 1840-1926,  為法國畫家，印象派創立者之一 )  在離巴黎不遠的吉維尼 (Giverny) 住家屋旁，開鑿了一個人工池塘，池內種植蓮花，還建了一座日式小橋。直到過世前的二十幾年，Monet 將身心安置於這一方恬靜水塘。他畫作的內容主題，幾乎都以這池塘花園為對象。以不同的視角畫水面的睡蓮、池邊的垂柳、鳶尾花，日本古橋。他持續不斷地在晨曦、黃昏、雨露等不同時刻，捕捉池塘光影和色彩的變化。把藍天浮雲、搖曳柳條、木橋曲線、池面睡蓮以及園裡的花草，構成一系列畫幅。晚年由於白內障眼疾，筆觸轉為粗曠、寫意，畫幅由小而大，甚至大到長十七公尺的巨幅畫作。莫內生命終點前的這些睡蓮畫作，色彩豐富，筆觸奔放，在水影掩映中，閃動著流離的色彩波光。莫內一生共畫了250多幅蓮花畫作，分別收藏於世界各地美術舘。巴黎的 Orangerie 美術館收藏莫內晚年12幅大型蓮花作品。
《 孤戀花 》 台灣民謠
作詞：周添旺   作曲：楊三郎
風微微　風微微　孤單悶悶在池邊
水蓮花　滿滿是　靜靜等待露水滴
啊……啊……
阮是思念郎君伊　暗想思　無講起
要講驚兄心懷疑
月光暝　月光暝　夜夜思君到深更
人消瘦　無元氣　為君唱出斷腸詩
points.en:
Mention Van Gogh, and one imagines a sky brilliant with stars; mention Monet, and a pond of shimmering water lilies comes to mind. Monet (Claude Monet, 1840–1926, French painter and one of the founders of Impressionism) dug an artificial pond beside his home at Giverny, not far from Paris, planted water lilies in it, and built a small Japanese-style bridge. Until the last twenty-some years of his life, Monet settled his body and spirit at this tranquil pond. Nearly all the subjects of his paintings were drawn from this pond garden. From different angles he painted the water lilies on the surface, the weeping willows by the pond, irises, and the old Japanese bridge. He continuously captured the changing light and color of the pond at different moments — dawn, dusk, after rain — composing a series of paintings from the blue sky and floating clouds, swaying willow branches, the curve of the wooden bridge, the water lilies on the pond, and the flowers and plants in the garden. In his later years, due to cataracts, his brushwork turned bolder and more expressive, and his canvases grew from small to large, some as large as seventeen meters wide. These water lily paintings from the end of Monet's life are rich in color and unrestrained in brushstroke, their shimmering colors flickering amid the reflections on the water. Monet painted more than 250 water lily paintings over his lifetime, now held in museums around the world. The Musée de l'Orangerie in Paris holds twelve large late-period water lily works by Monet.
'Solitary Love Flower' (Taiwanese folk song)
Lyrics: Chou Tian-wang. Music: Yang San-lang.
The wind blows soft, the wind blows soft, alone and sorrowful by the pond,
The water lilies bloom full, quietly waiting for dewdrops to fall.
Ah... ah...
I am longing for my beloved, silently pining, not daring to speak,
For fear that speaking would make him doubt my heart.
Moonlit night, moonlit night, night after night I think of him till deep night,
I grow thin and listless, singing out this heartbroken song for my love.
